title: Molecular Foundry
content:
Aerogel National Laboratory. The Molecular Foundry at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory in Berkeley, California, is a U.S. Department of Energy Office of Science user facility for nanoscience. It gives researchers from around the world access to leading-edge instrumentation and staff expertise across synthesis, fabrication, characterization, and theory of nanoscale materials.

Its multidisciplinary environment supports the design of porous and nanostructured materials, making it relevant for aerogel synthesis routes, imaging of nanoscale architecture, and structure-property studies. External users collaborate with staff or access facilities through a peer-reviewed proposal process.
